Product Features

  • This modern coffee table combines functionality and classic aesthetics to become an eye-catcher in your living room. With its dimensions of 100 × 50 × 35 cm, its generous surface offers enough space for drinks, decorative items or electronic devices and is ideal for gaming, watching movies or working from home.
  • The table features a thoughtful, integrated cable management design: the large open interior (69.5×22×23 cm) accommodates set-top boxes, routers or game consoles, allowing for organized cable storage, keeping the living room neat and tidy.
  • The integrated LED light strip can be conveniently controlled via app – light colour and brightness can be individually adjusted to create the ideal atmosphere for different situations.
  • The table is made of high-quality MDF board, is robust and supports up to 30 kg. The white high-gloss surface is scratch-resistant and waterproof and can be easily wiped clean in everyday life - ideal for frequent use.
  • Its comfortable height of 35 cm makes it ideal for everyday use, and its minimalist design fits perfectly with various interior styles, including modern, Scandinavian, and e-sports. Installation is quick and easy, requires no special tools and is done in a few minutes.
